messages:
Mika: FYI sharing a new customer-facing runbook — "Reservoir go-live checklist" for caching, batching, streaming, and renewal-risk signals. Short, actionable. Link: https://go.redwood/reservoir-checklist :eyes: Please review — want to ship to AE enablement deck tomorrow.

Laura: Quick skim — love the flow. Two additions: 1) explicit client-side prefill TTL guidance, 2) fallback model variant + routing policy. Example header to include in appendix:

```
Cache-Control: private, max-age=60
X-Redwood-Prefill: tenant_id=12345;mode=warm
```

Dan: Add telemetry event names and a simple Pulse query for renewals/latency regression. Example:

```
SELECT count(*) FROM rpc_logs WHERE event='prefill_miss' AND tenant_id=? AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'
```

Also recommend adding a short script customers can paste to run a quick local prefill test (curl + auth).

Sean: SRE note — include an Ops escalation line and warm-pool autoscale tip: if go-live > 500qps set warm_pool_size = 2x expected burst. Also add `--canary disable` flag for the first 10m of traffic when doing tenant rollouts.

sre-bot: scheduled maintenance window 2026-05-02 02:00-03:00 UTC — doc updated with note.

Ashley: Could we get a one-page "pre-call checklist" for AEs? It should be < 6 bullets so CS can print/send ahead of kickoff. I'll draft and attach to the runbook if approved. Also request to include a feedback capture form snippet — e.g. capture 3 failing prompts + prompt id + sample output + 'seed' so eng-ml can repro.

Mika: Perfect. Action items:
- [ ] Laura add cache header appendix
- [ ] Dan add telemetry queries + curl test
- [ ] Sean add ops escalation wording + autoscale numbers
- [ ] Ashley produce one-pager pre-call
I'll collect edits and publish v1 by EOD. Thanks all :tada:

Laura: ACK — will PR in 45m.
Dan: Will drop the curl snippet to the doc in ~1h.
Sean: I'll ping oncall and add the escalation playbook link.
Ashley: I'll post the one-pager draft to this thread when ready.

Mika: Quick note for renewal signals: capture increase in prefill_miss rate + drop in successful_streams as early warning. Suggest threshold = 3x baseline for alerts.

Ashley: Noted — I'll add that into the pre-call talking points.

Mika: closing for now. If anyone has strong objections DM me, otherwise I'll merge and share with AEs by 18:00 UTC.
